plugins.name: Tune: EmuReady
plugins.summary: Sets a game up from EmuReady listings of devices like yours (the same device, the same chip, then similar graphics): resolution, renderer and frame skip for the core EmuDEN uses, for that game only, after you agree. Undo puts them back.

plugins.name: Tune: Helix SR
plugins.summary: Puts Helix SR's FSR 4 upscaler (HLX FSR 4) into Steam games that ship FSR 3.1, as a drop-in for the game's own FSR library. Helix SR is downloaded from its official release; EmuDEN lists every file first, keeps the original and puts it back on Remove. Games with anti-cheat are refused.

plugins.name: Tune: LSFG
plugins.summary: Lossless Scaling frame generation for Steam games on Linux and SteamOS, through lsfg-vk: installs the lsfg-vk layer from its official build and switches 2x, 3x or 4x on per game in the game's launch options, after you agree. You need Lossless Scaling from Steam. On Windows, Lossless Scaling is its own program.

plugins.name: Tune: ProtonDB
plugins.summary: Sets your Steam games up from ProtonDB reports of machines like yours: the Proton version and launch options that worked, applied on SteamOS after you agree. On Windows it shows what the reports say.
